fx_note: Americas, Europe and Israel net pay and rents are converted from T0-35 EUR figures to USD using T0-35's ECB reference rate of 2026-11-13 (1 EUR = 1.1052 USD; T0-35 L190). Gulf, India and Asia-Pacific figures use T0-36's USD figures derived from ECB cross rates around 2026-11-11 (INR 93.92, SGD 1.2816, JPY 158.33, KRW 1,358.7, AUD 1.4554, NZD 1.8039, CNY 6.6713, HKD 7.8374, MYR 4.059, TWD 31.522, AED 3.6725, SAR 3.75; treated as +/-2% error band; T0-36 L198).
description: Evidence-graded country and city scoring model for GenAI careers across 33 jurisdictions covered by T0-35 (Americas, Europe and Israel) and T0-36 (Gulf, India and Asia-Pacific), combined with cross-border remote-hiring evidence from T0-43 (D-025). All tax, visa and residency summaries are dated pointers, not legal or tax advice.
scoring_method: Each country carries eight 0-10 pillars scored as triangular intervals [lo, mid, hi]. Wider intervals encode thin samples, conflicting sources, Grade C/D inputs or active policy/geopolitical shocks. scripts/rank_countries.py runs deterministic Monte Carlo sampling (20,000 draws, seeded RNG) across six weighted lenses to produce mean scores, median ranks and P10-P90 rank bands (all composite rankings are Grade M). Extract-only Grade A claims in T0-36 were downgraded to Grade B unless verified directly at primary official sources on 2026-11-19.

demand.label: Demand
demand.description: Volume and AI-skill share of GenAI/AI job postings across measured platforms.
demand.scale: 0 = negligible measured market; 5 = moderate regional hub; 10 = dominant global volume and share.

pay_ppp.label: Local purchasing power
pay_ppp.description: How far local tech net pay stretches against local rent and living costs (Numbeo LPP and post-rent share).
pay_ppp.scale: 0 = severe cost squeeze; 5 = moderate savings power; 10 = top global post-rent purchasing power.

net_pay.label: Net pay (USD)
net_pay.description: Absolute annual net take-home pay and post-rent disposable surplus in USD at reference tech salaries.
net_pay.scale: 0 = very low USD net surplus (<$15k); 5 = mid-tier ($50k-$65k net); 10 = global ceiling ($150k+ net).

access_india.label: Access (Indian national)
access_india.description: Speed, predictability, salary-floor achievability and permanent-residency path for Indian citizens.
access_india.scale: 0 = effectively closed; 5 = moderate employer sponsorship or slow/uncertain settlement; 10 = home market (zero visa friction).

access_non_eu.label: Access (non-EU national)
access_non_eu.description: Legal entry and settlement path for a generic non-EU national without India-specific backlogs or bilateral quotas.
access_non_eu.scale: 0 = effectively closed; 5 = moderate sponsorship with caps/waits; 10 = fast, predictable entry and settlement.

remote_reach.label: Remote reach from India
remote_reach.description: Practical feasibility of working remotely from India for employers in that country (IST overlap, remote share, documented EOR/cross-border hiring).
remote_reach.scale: 0 = closed or zero overlap with negligible hiring; 5 = moderate overlap or mixed local-entity/geo-gated hiring; 10 = strong overlap and open cross-border remote demand.

ecosystem.label: AI ecosystem
ecosystem.description: Frontier AI labs, Big Tech and GCC R&D density, venture funding and public compute programmes.
ecosystem.scale: 0 = minimal AI R&D presence; 5 = active regional startup/corporate hub; 10 = global frontier-lab and VC epicentre.

stability.label: Policy and macro stability
stability.description: Predictability of immigration, tax, AI regulation and regional geopolitical/security conditions as of November 2026.
stability.scale: 0 = severe active conflict or abrupt closure; 5 = material policy churn or regional risk; 10 = highly predictable legal and macro regime.

lenses.name: Overall (Indian national)
lenses.description: Balanced destination ranking for an Indian national weighing demand, net pay, local purchasing power, India-specific legal access, ecosystem, stability and remote reach.

lenses.name: Overall (generic non-EU national)
lenses.description: Balanced destination ranking for a generic non-EU national without India's US EB-2/EB-3 green-card backlog, India-specific bilateral quotas (MATES, India-NZ FTA) or IST remote-overlap weighting.

lenses.name: Highest net pay and disposable income

lenses.name: Fastest legal access (Indian nationals)

lenses.name: Remote work from India (employer markets)
